newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks post mild gains in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks post mild gains in slow trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks posted mild gains in somewhat slower trade on Thursday.
* Eight of 13 active issues rose, two fell, two were flat and one traded for the first time.
* Volume was slightly lower at 17,146 units, turnover halved to 6.7 million kuna.
* Top gainer textile firm Varteks added 10.5 kuna to 73, but it sold only six shares.
* Bigger of the two decliners, hotelier Suncani Hvar, edged down two kuna to 55, with 1,500 shares sold.
* Most active food processor Podravka eased two kuna to 283 on volume of 4,462 shares.
* Cutlery maker Kordun from Karlovac traded for the first time ever, closing at 145 kuna with 2,418 shares sold.
